messages.author: 38de4d265fc9ec95
messages.subject: Re: How to make geom_ribbon work with a step plot?
parts:
Hello Ista:
Thank you very much for your quick reply. However, your solution does not work. The confidence interval need to look like a step function as well. If I plot both your code and mine, please note that they are not the same, as they are regions that are not shaded by geom_ribbon.

g <- ggplot(plot.result) +
  geom_step(aes(x=time, y=surv, color=group), size=1.2) +

xlab("Time") + ylab("Survival") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(title=element_text(size=15), axis.text=element_text(size=15),

legend.title=element_blank(),
        legend.text=element_text(size=15), legend.key.size=unit(1, "cm"))

g <- g + geom_ribbon(aes(x = time, ymin = surv-1.96*se, ymax =
                      surv+1.96*se, fill=group, alpha = 0.25))

g <- g + 
  geom_step(aes(x=time, y=surv-1.96*se, color=group), linetype='dotted', size=0.5) +
  geom_step(aes(x=time, y=surv+1.96*se, color=group), linetype='dotted', size=0.5)


g

Thanks,


Maria
